name: xero-mcp
description: Every Xero Accounting read plus a local SQLite ledger  -  aging, reconciliation, and GL tie-out that no other Xero tool computes offline.

xero_access_token.title: XERO_ACCESS_TOKEN
xero_access_token.description: Optional. Sets XERO_ACCESS_TOKEN for the Xero MCP server.

xero_accounting_oauth2.title: XERO_ACCOUNTING_OAUTH2
xero_accounting_oauth2.description: Optional. Sets XERO_ACCOUNTING_OAUTH2 for the Xero MCP server.

xero_tenant_id.title: XERO_TENANT_ID
xero_tenant_id.description: Required. Tenant UUID sent as the Xero-Tenant-Id header on every call (find it via GET /connections after minting a token).
